test_case.name: Readiness Probe Misconfigured (Wrong HTTP Path / Port)
test_case.scenario_description: The catalog search service ('catalog-service') in pod 'catalog-search-7f8e9d6c4-b3n5m' (namespace 'storefront') initializes cleanly and serves traffic on port 8080 with health check endpoint '/api/v1/healthz'. However, the Deployment's readinessProbe is misconfigured to query 'http://10.244.2.48:8080/healthz', which returns HTTP 404 Not Found. Kubelet marks the pod Unhealthy (0/1 Ready) without restarting the container.
test_case.injected_fault: Deployment spec.template.spec.containers[0].readinessProbe.httpGet.path set to '/healthz' instead of '/api/v1/healthz', returning HTTP 404.
test_case.ground_truth_rca: Pod 'catalog-search-7f8e9d6c4-b3n5m' (container 'catalog-service') is marked Unready because its Kubernetes readinessProbe is querying '/healthz' (returning HTTP 404 Not Found) instead of the application's actual health endpoint '/api/v1/healthz'.

suggested_remediation: Verify whether the application process is overwhelmed or deadlocked during probe execution.
Inspect probe configuration in pod spec (`initialDelaySeconds`, `periodSeconds`, `timeoutSeconds`, `failureThreshold`).
Increase `timeoutSeconds` if the application takes longer to respond under load (e.g. from 1s to 5s).
If initialization takes significant time (e.g. heavy DB migrations or cache warming), implement a `startupProbe` to shield the `livenessProbe`.
Verify healthcheck handler logic: ensure health checks don't make blocking synchronous calls to unready downstream dependencies.

remediations.description: Inspect probe configuration and correct readiness/liveness path, port, or timeout.
remediations.yaml_patch:
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 15
  periodSeconds: 10
  timeoutSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3
remediations.explanation: Verifies the configured probe endpoint and gives the application sufficient time to respond.

remediations.description: Introduce a startupProbe to protect long-starting applications.
remediations.yaml_patch:
startupProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  failureThreshold: 30
  periodSeconds: 10
remediations.explanation: Ensures readiness/liveness probes do not fail while the application is still initializing.
